description: This Java source file defines the AlarmStorage class responsible for persisting and retrieving Alarm objects using SharedPreferences in an Android environment. It includes methods for saving, fetching, and deleting alarms, utilizing shared preferences and handling storage context initialization based on Android version.

classes.name: AlarmStorage
classes.description: Manages the persistent storage and retrieval of Alarm objects, utilizing SharedPreferences for storage, with special handling for Android N and above to use device-protected storage.

methods.name: AlarmStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SharedPreferences based on Android version, handling migration to device-protected storage as needed.

methods.name: saveAlarm
methods.description: Creates an Alarm object with specified time parameters, assigns a secure random ID, saves it into SharedPreferences, and returns the Alarm instance.

methods.name: getAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves all stored alarms from SharedPreferences and returns them as a Set of Alarm objects.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Removes a specified Alarm object from SharedPreferences by matching its ID.
